body:
Real, new PARENA compiler capability: src/emit_llvm.c gets its first FFI mechanism (#target {:llvm (inline-llvm "...")} + top-level llvm-extern declarations), closing a real, confirmed zero-FFI gap. Live-verified end to end: parena build -> real llc -mtriple=x86_64-pc-linux-gnu -> linked via clang -> executed, correct result. stdlib/reflux/reflux.prn (:llvm key added) and new stdlib/net/tcp_llvm.prn (raw tcp-listen/accept/close) both compile and link into EDGE.GAME's own new build/edge_relay binary. 19 new tests (71/71 in test_emit_llvm.c), make test 347/347 zero regressions. Commit 8db24cf.

⚓ ☃
title: LLVM :llvm FFI hatch + llvm-extern -- reflux.prn and tcp_llvm.prn ported
